summary: Vale filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) clarifying the sanction and July 27, 2026 resignation of Marcelo Gasparino, former Board member and Vice-Chairman, over deliberate disclosure of confidential June 19, 2026 board meeting information. The Board acted on Audit and Compliance and Audit and Risk Committee recommendations, supported by an independent external law firm investigation. Gasparino admitted sending an external analyst a draft statement and vote. Brazil's CVM opened an administrative proceeding; Vale served cease-and-desist notice and threatens criminal action. The Reference Form was updated.
